rule: Standard returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. High-value electronics must be returned within 14 days.
Products with verified physical or shipping damage qualify for a 100% full refund or immediate replacement, with return shipping fees waived.
Automated instant refunds are capped at $500. Any claim exceeding $500 requires human manager approval.
Accounts with more than 3 claims in the last 90 days or a fraud score exceeding 70 are flagged for mandatory human review.
